title: RPZ repair kit: a model-specific parts decision, not a generic purchase
description: RPZ kits must match the specific assembly and service zone.
prompt: Which RPZ model, size, and failed zone does the kit need to address?
answer: RPZ kits must match the specific assembly and service zone. A relief-related symptom, first check issue, second check issue, or cover service can lead to different parts and procedures.
urgency: Do not infer RPZ compatibility from size alone. Escalate unknown model labels, body damage, inaccessible drainage, or unverified test findings.
identifiers: Record whether the finding concerns relief discharge, a check, a cover, or external piping.
Match the kit to the exact manufacturer model and nominal size.
Relief service needs drainage and retest planning in addition to a part reference.

choices.label: I know the model and size
choices.detail: Use model-specific sources before ordering parts or accepting a repair scope.

choices.label: The assembly is leaking or failed
choices.detail: Document the location and obtain a qualified diagnosis before repair.

choices.label: The body may be damaged
choices.detail: Compare repair with a complete replacement and retest scope.

steps.title: Observe and identify
steps.body: Keep the failed report with a full model-label photograph.

steps.title: Match the verified path
steps.body: Confirm the exact kit scope against official manufacturer service documentation.

steps.title: Close the risk loop
steps.body: Plan isolation, drainage, repair, retest, and utility closeout as one job.
